title: Successfully Delivered Fully Automated Assembly Line for 86" Commercial Display Screens to Mexico
contentHtml:
In February 2026, TXAM successfully delivered a customized fully automated assembly line for 86" commercial display screens to a well-known commercial display manufacturer in Mexico, with 5 containers of complete line equipment shipped cross-border.

Project Overview

This production line covers core processes such as automatic dispensing, high-precision lamination, and automatic screw locking, perfectly solving the challenge of damage-free assembly for ultra-large flexible screens. This marks another major breakthrough for TXAM in the Americas market, following its success in Southeast Asia.

Technical Highlights

The entire line uses TXAM's self-developed high-precision robot dispensing system (±0.2mm), combined with UVW vision alignment platform, achieving high-precision lamination of large-size panels. Through the intelligent control system, the production line can achieve one-click product switching, compatible with 65~110" multi-size products.

After overseas delivery, the equipment has been operating stably, receiving high praise from the customer and laying a solid foundation for further in-depth cooperation.
